question: Does separating the current unified Spot profile into a Physical Space Archetype and a Location Profile improve future lead prioritization while preserving interpretability?
hypothesis: A decomposition of Spot into physical and location profiles will improve or preserve future ranking quality while producing clearer, more actionable clusters than a single Spot profile dominated by geography.
primary_change: replace the unified spot_profile with separate physical_space_profile and location_profile in the treatment arm
secondary_changes: run a full relational/data-completeness gate before modeling
add the same backward as-of availability state and snapshot-lag features to both A and B arms
report inquiry-level metrics and lead-level robustness
pre-register a randomized online A/B protocol with sticky lead-level assignment

target.censoring: The public candidate data has no visit timestamp or true sale. The recorded scheduled_visit response is treated as the observed proxy outcome; the online protocol requires 30-day lead-level outcome maturation.

population.eligibility: Inquiries after the frozen early profile-calibration window; the final 20% by inquiry_at is held out for future evaluation.
exclusions: The first 30% of inquiries remain reserved for profile calibration and are not used to fit the predictive A/B models.

removed: unified spot_profile from treatment arm only; retained unchanged in control arm

validation.strategy: offline temporal A/B backtest plus pre-registered online randomized A/B design
validation.split_description: Offline: reuse the parent profile cutoff and final-20% future test cutoff; train only between those cutoffs and score the untouched future period. A and B use the exact same rows and common features. Online: 50/50 sticky randomization by lead_id, stratified by search_sector, search_modality and user_type.

items.information_available_at: spot listing fields available by inquiry_at; clusterer fitted only on spots created before the frozen profile cutoff
items.evidence: Mutable current-state spot fields days_on_market, total_inquiries, total_views and is_active are excluded. Physical profiles exclude geography.

items.information_available_at: spot listing fields available by inquiry_at; clusterer fitted only on spots created before the frozen profile cutoff
items.evidence: The profile uses only listing location fields and is frozen before predictive training.
Backward as-of join explicitly forbids future availability snapshots; the audit reports coverage and snapshot lag.

items.information_available_at: profile calibration window ending before predictive train/test
items.evidence: Assignments are inherited from the frozen profile experiment; broker profiles were constructed from the early calibration window.
